name: How do I choose the right contractor for my shower or tub upgrade in the East Bay?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my shower or tub upgrade in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience in bathroom renovations, especially with shower and tub upgrades. Verify their licensing and insurance. Request references and review their portfolio of past work. It's also important to get detailed quotes from multiple contractors and ensure clear communication regarding project scope, timeline, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, insurance, references, portfolio, clear communication, and detailed quotes.
